rule.continuation: at least two of four targets pass on Table 9
rule.dose_monotonicity: abs(mean quarter-pool delta) >= abs(mean half-pool delta)
rule.same_sign: quarter-pool paired deltas have the same nonzero sign in both blocks
rule.sigma: within-anchor residual SD of 3 proportional and 2 anchor-B full-support controls, pooled with 3 df
rule.target_pass: all three criteria at either anchor
rule.threshold: abs(mean quarter-pool paired delta over blocks 0 and 1) > 2*sigma
